records.jp: さて、本日お集まりいただいたのは他でもありません！<CR>皆さんにやってもらいたいのは……
records.en_original: Ahem, thank you all for coming. I have gathered you all here today for one reason and one reason alone...
records.en_auxiliary: Ahem, thank you all for coming. I have gathered you all here today for one reason and one reason alone...
records.en: Now then, I have gathered you here today for no ordinary reason!<CR>What I want everyone to do is...

records.jp: 食材集めです！
records.en_original: ...to gather ingredients!
records.en_auxiliary: ...to gather ingredients!
records.en: Gather ingredients!

records.jp: そんなもったいぶって言うこと？
records.en_original: That's your grand announcement?
records.en_auxiliary: That's your grand announcement?
records.en: Did that really need such a buildup?

records.jp: 今回はひと味違うんだな～
records.en_original: This time is a little different though!
records.en_auxiliary: This time is a little different though!
records.en: This time is a little different~

records.jp: なんてったって、あたしも参加するんだから！
records.en_original: That's because I will also be taking part!
records.en_auxiliary: That's because I will also be taking part!
records.en: Because I'm joining in too!

records.jp: おお～
records.en_original: Oooh!
records.en_auxiliary: Oooh!
records.en: Ooh~

records.jp: 別に今までだって、<CR>勝手についてきてたでしょ
records.en_original: You usually tag along anyways...
records.en_auxiliary: You usually tag along anyways...
records.en: You've always followed along<CR>on your own anyway.

records.jp: 今回は正式に依頼されたんだよ！<CR>「金城さん、お願いしてもいいですか？」って
records.en_original: Yes, but I've gotten an official request this time! "Yuki, could I ask you a favor?" they said!
records.en_auxiliary: Yes, but I've gotten an official request this time! "Yuki, could I ask you a favor?" they said!
records.en: This time I was officially asked!<CR>'Kinjou-san, may I ask you?' she said!

records.jp: その言い方は詩帆ちゃん？
records.en_original: Who's that supposed to be, Shiho?
records.en_auxiliary: Who's that supposed to be, Shiho?
records.en: Was that supposed to be Shiho-chan?

records.jp: ご明察！
records.en_original: Correct, little miss!
records.en_auxiliary: Correct, little miss!
records.en: Precisely!

records.jp: やったぁ
records.en_original: Yay.
records.en_auxiliary: Yay.
records.en: Yay.

records.jp: まぁ、ここも人数が増えたから、<CR>他の誰かが留守番してくれるんでしょうけど
records.en_original: I suppose now that we have more people, someone has to stay and watch the school.
records.en_auxiliary: I suppose now that we have more people, someone has to stay and watch the school.
records.en: Well, now that there are more people here,<CR>I suppose someone else can watch the school.

records.jp: 役割分担どうする？
records.en_original: How should we decide who does what?
records.en_auxiliary: How should we decide who does what?
records.en: How should we divide up the roles?

records.jp: 私はココロトープに行く予定
records.en_original: I'm planning to go to the Heartscape.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm planning to go to the Heartscape.
records.en: I'm planning to go to a Heartscape.

records.jp: わたしは学校周りに生えてる植物を集めようかな
records.en_original: I was thinking of gathering some of the plants growing around the school.
records.en_auxiliary: I was thinking of gathering some of the plants growing around the school.
records.en: Maybe I'll gather the plants growing around the school.

records.jp: え？　みんなバラバラで行く感じ？
records.en_original: Huh? We're splitting up?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? We're splitting up?
records.en: Huh? Are we all going separately?

records.jp: その方が短時間で済むし、<CR>それぞれの特技を活かせるでしょ
records.en_original: That way we'll finish quicker, and everyone can do what they're best at.
records.en_auxiliary: That way we'll finish quicker, and everyone can do what they're best at.
records.en: It'll take less time that way,<CR>and each of us can use our specialties.

records.jp: これだから効率厨は。<CR>じゃ、あたしは二人が行くとこ以外
records.en_original: Fine, fine. I'll go wherever is the most efficient or whatever.
records.en_auxiliary: Fine, fine. I'll go wherever is the most efficient or whatever.
records.en: This is why efficiency freaks are the worst.<CR>Fine, I'll go anywhere the other two aren't going.

records.jp: 雑っ
records.en_original: Oh, Yuki...
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, Yuki...
records.en: That's vague.

records.jp: 私は伶那さんを手伝おうかな
records.en_original: I think I'll go with Rena.
records.en_auxiliary: I think I'll go with Rena.
records.en: Maybe I'll help Rena-san.

records.jp: 私は一人でいい
records.en_original: I don't need any help.
records.en_auxiliary: I don't need any help.
records.en: I'm fine on my own.

records.jp: いいの～？<CR>こわ～いモンスターが出るかもよ～？
records.en_original: Are you suuure? There might be scary demons out there!
records.en_auxiliary: Are you suuure? There might be scary demons out there!
records.en: Are you suuuure?<CR>A scaaary monster might appear~

records.jp: でも、伶那さんがそう言うなら<CR>他の人のお手伝いを……
records.en_original: But if you really think so, I can go with someone else...
records.en_auxiliary: But if you really think so, I can go with someone else...
records.en: But if Rena-san says so,<CR>I'll go help someone else...

records.jp: しょうがない。<CR>ついでにあなたの稽古もつけてあげる
records.en_original: Fine. Maybe you'll learn something.
records.en_auxiliary: Fine. Maybe you'll learn something.
records.en: Fine.<CR>I'll train you while we're there too.

records.jp: （もー、素直じゃないんだから）
records.en_original: (Sheesh, just admit you want me to come already.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Sheesh, just admit you want me to come already.)
records.en: (Geez, she just can't be honest.)

records.jp: 私はこころを手伝おうかな。見分け方とか<CR>教えてもらえればいけるんじゃないかな、たぶん
records.en_original: Maybe I'll give Kokoro a hand. I should be able to help as long as you teach me how to tell the different plants apart.
records.en_auxiliary: Maybe I'll give Kokoro a hand. I should be able to help as long as you teach me how to tell the different plants apart.
records.en: Maybe I'll help Kokoro. If you teach me<CR>how to tell them apart, I can probably manage.

records.jp: ふふ、本当に？<CR>頼もしいなぁ
records.en_original: Hehe, really? I knew I could count on you!
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe, really? I knew I could count on you!
records.en: Hehe, really?<CR>That's reassuring.

records.jp: でも気を付けてね。<CR>間違うと死んじゃったりするから
records.en_original: But you need to be careful. One small mistake and we poison everybody.
records.en_auxiliary: But you need to be careful. One small mistake and we poison everybody.
records.en: But be careful.<CR>If you get it wrong, you could die.

records.jp: え、マジ？
records.en_original: S-seriously?
records.en_auxiliary: S-seriously?
records.en: Wait, seriously?

records.jp: まぁ、わたしも確認するから大丈夫
records.en_original: Don't worry, I'll double-check everything.
records.en_auxiliary: Don't worry, I'll double-check everything.
records.en: Well, I'll check too, so it'll be fine.

records.jp: （冗談……だよね？）
records.en_original: (She's just kidding...right?)
records.en_auxiliary: (She's just kidding...right?)
records.en: (That was a joke... right?)

records.jp: 私は勇希を手伝うよ。<CR>そんな広い範囲一人じゃしんどいって
records.en_original: I'll give Yuki a hand. It'd be tough to cover so much ground alone.
records.en_auxiliary: I'll give Yuki a hand. It'd be tough to cover so much ground alone.
records.en: I'll help Yuki.<CR>Covering that much ground alone would be rough.

records.jp: あは、やっぱり？<CR>だったらお言葉に甘えちゃおっかな～
records.en_original: Yay! Glad to have you!
records.en_auxiliary: Yay! Glad to have you!
records.en: Aha, thought so?<CR>Then maybe I'll take you up on that~

records.jp: それに適度にサボれそうだし
records.en_original: We can slack off more with two people.
records.en_auxiliary: We can slack off more with two people.
records.en: Besides, it seems like we can slack off a reasonable amount.

records.jp: うん、それは保証する
records.en_original: The perfect plan.
records.en_auxiliary: The perfect plan.
records.en: Yeah, I guarantee that.

records.jp: ところで、何を集めてきてほしいとか言われたの？
records.en_original: So what did Shiho ask us for anyway?
records.en_auxiliary: So what did Shiho ask us for anyway?
records.en: By the way, did Shiho tell you what she wants us to gather?

records.jp: えっと
records.en_original: Um...
records.en_auxiliary: Um...
records.en: Um...

records.jp: し、詩帆の腕前だったら<CR>ありあわせでいけるっしょ！
records.en_original: I-I'm sure she can make do with whatever we find.
records.en_auxiliary: I-I'm sure she can make do with whatever we find.
records.en: W-with Shiho's skills,<CR>she can make do with whatever's on hand, right!

records.jp: テンション上がって忘れたみたいね
records.en_original: You forgot, didn't you.
records.en_auxiliary: You forgot, didn't you.
records.en: Looks like you got excited and forgot.

records.jp: もう一回聞きに行こっか
records.en_original: Let's go ask her.
records.en_auxiliary: Let's go ask her.
records.en: Shall we go ask her again?

records.jp: はーい
records.en_original: Okaaaay.
records.en_auxiliary: Okaaaay.
records.en: Okaay.
